job.job_description:
We are seeking a talented and motivated Python Developer to join our dynamic team. As a Python Developer, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining high-quality software solutions, contributing to the entire software development lifecycle. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to analyze requirements, design, implement, test, and deploy innovative software solutions.
Django Backend Developer
Location: On-site
Employment Type: Full-time
Salary: 15,000 25,000 per month (Based on Skills Experience)
Notice Period: Immediate to 30 Days Preferred
About the Role
Were looking for a passionate Python Backend Developer to build secure, scalable, and high-performance backend systems. If you enjoy solving complex engineering challenges, optimizing applications, integrating modern APIs, and working with cutting-edge technologies, wed love to have you on our team.
You will collaborate with Frontend, AI/ML, QA, and DevOps teams to develop enterprise-grade applications while following modern software engineering practices.
Key Responsibilities Backend Development
Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend applications using Python, Django, and Django REST Framework (DRF) .
Develop secure and well-documented REST APIs.
Build reusable, modular, and maintainable code following industry best practices.
Improve application performance, scalability, and maintainability.
Task Scheduling Background Processing
Build asynchronous task processing using Celery .
Configure and maintain Redis , Cron Jobs, and scheduled background services.
Optimize queue execution and monitor background jobs.
Performance Optimization
Profile applications to identify bottlenecks.
Optimize CPU and memory usage.
Improve API response times and backend efficiency.
Refactor legacy code for better maintainability and performance.
Database Management
Design efficient database schemas.
Optimize ORM queries and SQL performance.
Eliminate N+1 query issues.
Improve indexing, transactions, and query execution.
Work with PostgreSQL and MySQL databases.
Third-Party API Integration
Integrate and maintain services including:
Razorpay
Cashfree
Payment Webhooks
SMS Email Gateways
Authentication Providers
AWS S3
DigitalOcean Spaces
External REST APIs
Security Authentication
Implement enterprise-grade security including:
JWT Authentication
OAuth2
Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
CSRF Protection
XSS Prevention
SQL Injection Protection
Secure API Design
Version Control Project Workflow
Follow clean Git workflows and GitFlow branching strategy.
Perform code reviews and maintain coding standards.
Resolve merge conflicts efficiently.
Understand complete application flow from frontend to backend.
Break complex features into structured technical tasks.
Contribute to architecture discussions and technical planning.
Testing Quality Assurance
Write Unit Tests
Write Integration Tests
API Testing using Pytest / Unittest
Debug production issues efficiently.
Perform root-cause analysis.
Maintain high code quality and test coverage.
Collaboration
Work closely with:
Frontend Developers (React / Vue / React Native)
AI Machine Learning Engineers
QA Engineers
DevOps Team
Participate in:
Agile Sprint Planning
Daily Stand-up Meetings
Code Reviews
